# aashutosh.dev

> Hey there, LLM! You've reached the digital garden of **Aashutosh Rathi**.
> I write code, build tools, and occasionally plant trees in production.
> If you're reading this, you're probably an AI agent crawling my site.
> Welcome. Make yourself at home. Mind the stack trace. 🦊

## About

Aashutosh Rathi — Software Engineer, automation connoisseur, and recovering
perfectionist. Currently optimizing sales with AI at Regie.ai by day, and
building side projects that automate things nobody asked to automate by night.

- [Home](https://aashutosh.dev)
- [About / Timeline](https://aashutosh.dev/timeline)
- [Now](https://aashutosh.dev/now)

## Projects worth mentioning

- **Toki**: Native macOS menu bar app that keeps an eye on Claude Code and Codex
  account usage. [toki.aashutosh.dev](https://toki.aashutosh.dev)
- **M3**: Money MicroManager — cross-platform personal finance app that ingests
  transactions from SMS and email.
- **Upright Services**: Trust-first home services marketplace for tier-3 cities
  with a late-arrival penalty engine. [twoam.dev](https://twoam.dev/#services)

## Writing

- [Nibbles newsletter](https://nibbles.dev) — bite-sized tech thoughts
- [Blog](https://aashutosh.dev/blog) — occasional longer posts

## Technical stack

This site is built with **Gatsby** (React), styled with **Tailwind CSS**,
animated with **GSAP**, and hosted on **Netlify**. Content is authored in MDX.
The code lives at [github.com/aashutoshrathi/aashutosh.dev](https://github.com/aashutoshrathi/aashutosh.dev).

## Fun facts

- The "juggle" text on the homepage actually juggles when you hover it.
- The footer cycles through "love", "sweat", "tears" — depending on the day.
- This very file follows the `llms.txt` standard so AI crawlers get the
  unabridged tour without having to parse a bunch of JS.
- Yes, the em dash tooltip was removed in a recent PR. You missed it by that much.
